axis_definitions.manuscript_text: Requirement reported in live manuscript prose or, when explicitly stated, only in an inactive candidate.

axis_definitions.active_tex_carrier: The content or pointer is reachable from the active TeX body manifest or a dedicated supplement TeX input; commented blueprints do not count.
axis_definitions.public_persistent_release: A publicly accessible persistent release exists. Local supplements and draft staging do not count.

status_definitions.READY: PRISMA content is adequately reported for the local submission package and any required local artifact exists.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Substantive content exists but an active carrier, final approval, terminology correction, or required display remains open.
status_definitions.JUSTIFIED_NA: The review design makes the item inapplicable and nonperformance plus its boundary are reported.
